final: WITH joined AS (SELECT ab.translink AS tlink, tr.tradekind AS ttype FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = t.trdref WHERE tr.tradekind IS NOT NULL), grp AS (SELECT tlink, ttype, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM joined GROUP BY tlink, ttype), tsum AS (SELECT ttype, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM grp GROUP BY ttype), ratio AS (SELECT g.ttype, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / s.total AS r FROM grp g JOIN tsum s ON s.ttype = g.ttype WHERE s.total IS NOT NULL), ravg AS (SELECT ttype, AVG(r) AS avgr FROM ratio GROUP BY ttype), kept AS (SELECT r.ttype, r.cnt, r.r, r.r - a.avgr AS d FROM ratio r JOIN ravg a ON a.ttype = r.ttype WHERE r.r > a.avgr) SELECT ttype, AVG(cnt), AVG(r), AVG(d) FROM kept GROUP BY ttype
